headline: Approved release live; autonomous work continues with decision emails tracked.
summary: Owner decision emails supplement HQ. Two Gmail sends are confirmed: initial decisions and the local sender setup request. Host pilot and exact release approvals were received. Release is now live; host outreach remains assigned to the owner within the approved five-organization scope.

Live 30-day metrics showed 11 discovery events, one signup start and one signup completion before release. These anonymous counters are not verified people or conversion rates; staff/test exclusions remain unknown. Local database account rows are not production traction. Actual attendance, returning customers and settled revenue remain unknown.

Initial planning scenarios are preserved for comparison: 25 new registrations by September 21; 200 base / 1,000 stretch by October 14. These are revisable assumptions, not fixed commitments or permission to buy empty growth. The dates become evidence-review checkpoints. No measured channel or verified production baseline supports a growth forecast yet. Set acquisition scale from real host capacity and compatible places; report missed assumptions and revisions openly.

Current business hypothesis: help a small real group attend something worthwhile, choose to return, and eventually make a voluntary settled payment for an implemented optional benefit at an owner-approved price. One payment would be an early signal, not proof of profitability. Existing Plus is a candidate offer that can be changed or rejected. Purchase intent is not revenue; no spending, pricing or payment activation is newly authorized.

Approved release d7064b7 is live at keepitup.social: Vercel dpl_EjVfwK7QgEFbmeuAyL3RXxEVkzTc is READY. Scope is d58c0e5 plus approved patch files from 98ac494. Later isolated joining/discovery changes were excluded. Landing, HQ, host-pilot packet, health and database readiness checks passed.

Completed a bounded dependency exposure review instead of assuming the 26 remaining npm findings require another broad upgrade. Fresh registry audit: 0 critical, 11 high, 15 moderate package findings. Tool returned exit 1 for findings, not a network failure. Image-size/Metro, PostCSS, js-yaml, fast-uri, xmldom and Vitest map to build/test tooling in reviewed paths. Undici 6.27.0 is runtime-reachable through Vercel Blob photo storage. Maintainer guidance and installed call sites did not establish an applicable exploit path: Blob uses fetch, not the advisory-specific duck-typed dispatcher path; no retry interceptor/cookie helper use found. This is bounded triage, not proof of safety. No dependency or product changes made.

Changed assumption: continuing small local improvements is no longer the best next use of a cycle after the concrete join/discovery repairs. No fresh customer evidence or additional verified core-flow blocker emerged. The host inquiry/session checklist is already prepared. Further interface work, repeated research or broad build-tool upgrades would not resolve the dominant commercial uncertainty. Defer speculative work; retain remaining dependency findings for evidence-triggered review.

Next evidence: owner executes the exact host-pilot card after approval, producing a real host commitment with format/date/capacity/responsibility, then worthwhile attendance and return. Establish deployment identity plus staff/test exclusions before calling aggregate account rows traction. An unsent inquiry is blocked execution, not channel failure. Preserve September 21/October 14 checkpoints and prior scenarios; no missed target is reset. Optional paid value follows actual usage and separate owner-approved pricing/payment scope.

Release passed 1,419 tests, workspace typechecks, lint and remote Next.js 16.3.5 build. Existing migration hook ran despite requested override; zero new migrations applied. Notification/reporting tests (16), runtime checks (37) and web typecheck passed. Cron, Redis and unattended email remain unverified. Worker started at 23:02:46Z with fresh heartbeat; completion is not yet claimed.

Interactive Gmail decision alerts work and both sends have private receipts. Recurring adapter and duplicate suppression are installed, but local OAuth access is missing; the setup card was also emailed. Enabled local product schedule continues while access is pending. Computer must remain awake, logged in and connected with valid existing ChatGPT access.

directions.title: Enable the selected sender for unattended decision emails
directions.detail: The first owner decision digest was sent through the connected Gmail account, and the selected sender/recipient are saved privately. The Windows scheduler cannot access the chat connector. A tested local Gmail adapter and duplicate-suppression queue are prepared; no local OAuth client ID, client secret or refresh token is available. HQ updates and product work continue.
directions.recommendation: Place the selected sender account's owner-authorized Gmail send-only OAuth credentials directly in ignored .env.studio.local: GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET and GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN; set GMAIL_SENDER_EMAIL to the selected sender, EMAIL_DELIVERY_PROVIDER=gmail and EMAIL_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true. STUDIO_OWNER_EMAIL and STUDIO_OWNER_EMAIL_FROM are already configured privately. Never paste secrets into HQ or chat. Existing authorization covers sending these decision alerts after configuration. Alternative: use HQ and interactive Gmail alerts until local access is configured; unattended delivery is not active yet. No paid service or production change is required.
